_provenance.purpose: C1 actor-bound measurement receipt. The originally specified bound (240, claimed p999=238/max=240) is CONTRADICTED by these measurements and was corrected.

query_1_stored_actor_all.sql: select count(*), percentile_cont(0.5|0.9|0.99|0.999) within group (order by char_length(actor)), max(char_length(actor)) from public.workflow_step where actor is not null

query_2_stored_actor_not_corrupt.sql: same as query_1 with AND NOT public.rosetta_v25_actor_source_corrupt(actor)

query_3_premodal_segment.sql: distribution of char_length of the pre-modal segment of rosetta_v2_normalize_text(step_name) over workflow_step rows whose step_name contains a modal

decision.bound_justification: Bound governs the pre-modal segment (query_3): measured p999=571.26 over n=156869. 1024 is the smallest power-of-two strictly above measured p999; it admits >=99.9% of observed legitimate clauses and blocks the runaway-capture tail (observed max 6566). The originally specified 240 is refuted by measurement (p99=254 > 240) and must not be used.
decision.prior_claim_status: REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT: the '240 (p999=238, max=240)' figures in the original implementation prompt do not match the live corpus.
